text: The applicant is a foreign citizen holding a foreign passport, in good physical and mental health, aged 18-25 years.Admission criteria1. The applicant is a foreign citizen holding a foreign passport and is in good physical and mental health.2. Applicants should have a high school diploma or above, and the selected courses in high school should be science (that is, including biology, chemistry, physics, mathematics and other subjects), and be between 18 and 25 years old.3. Applicants should have a strong English language ability. International students whose mother tongue is not English must provide proof of full English study in secondary school or proof of English proficiency test.
